key_insight: This review maps bias in AI disease detection and highlights data diversity, explainability, and fairness-aware design as priorities for more equitable systems.
clinical_relevance: Bias in diagnostic AI may undermine equitable performance across patient populations, making demographic evaluation and deployment safeguards important.
method: Reviewed disease-detection AI literature within a stated 2015–2026 search window.
Analyzed approaches by input data, model architecture, and bias type.
Examined algorithmic, demographic, model, and deployment bias and mitigation strategies.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 23 included articles from 64,389 records analyzed across seven digital libraries, without quantitative estimates of mitigation effectiveness.
watch_item: The review identifies research priorities but does not establish that any mitigation strategy improves diagnostic fairness in clinical deployment.
paper_title: Fairness or Fallacy? Mapping the Landscape of AI Bias in Disease Detection
